title: balanghas rubiginosa
intro: Balanghas rubiginosa, commonly known as Sambong or Blume, is a plant species in the family Urticaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Balanghas rubiginosa include its potential to alleviate fever, cough, and digestive problems, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties.
